title: BE Massage and Wellness
specs: Practitioner is a Reiki Master and graduate of Onondaga School of Therapeutic Massage
Safety protocols exceed NYS recommendations with hospital grade cleaners and HEPA filtration
Inform practitioner of any health problems or medications before session
Doctor's recommendation advised if under medical care

options.name: Full Body Massage
options.detail: A full body massage tailored to address your needs and specific areas of concern including deep tissue, trigger point therapy, myofascial release, stretching and relaxation techniques.

options.name: Upper Body Massage
options.detail: Focuses on tension and pain from desk work including headache, neck, shoulder and arm pain.

options.name: Manual Lymphatic Drainage (MLD)
options.detail: Gentle massage to encourage natural lymph drainage, supports immune system and autoimmune challenges.

options.name: Hot Stone Massage
options.detail: Uses penetrating heat from smooth, oiled stones combined with Swedish technique to relieve tense muscles and loosen joints.

options.name: Prenatal Massage
options.detail: Tailored massage for pregnant women to relax muscles, ease sore spots, improve circulation and mobility.

options.name: Reflexology
options.detail: Therapeutic method stimulating pressure points on feet and hands to promote wellness and healing.

options.name: Reiki
options.detail: Japanese technique for stress reduction and relaxation administered by laying on hands to promote healing.

options.name: AromaTouch™ Technique
options.detail: Clinical application of eight essential oils along energy meridians and reflexology points to promote relaxation, stress relief, immune support, pain decrease, and mood uplift.
